title: Uniform measure of an event
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $P$ be any decidable property of sign vectors $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$. The probability of the event $\{x:P(x)\}$ under the uniform measure on sign vectors equals the uniform probability of $P$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a predicate on sign vectors
